hook.en: Whether you're in air-conditioned Genting or scorching Kuala Lumpur, your body stays at about 37 °C. After a bowl of cendol, your blood sugar still returns to normal. Drink a lot of water and you pee more. That's homeostasis — your body's autopilot.
hook.bm: Sama ada anda di Genting yang sejuk atau Kuala Lumpur yang terik, suhu badan kekal kira-kira 37 °C. Selepas semangkuk cendol, gula darah kembali normal. Minum banyak air dan anda lebih kerap kencing. Itulah homeostasis — autopilot badan anda.

bigIdeas.en: Homeostasis keeps the internal environment constant using negative feedback.
bigIdeas.bm: Homeostasis mengekalkan persekitaran dalam yang malar menggunakan suap balik negatif.

bigIdeas.en: Body temperature, blood glucose and water balance are all regulated.
bigIdeas.bm: Suhu badan, glukosa darah dan keseimbangan air semuanya dikawal atur.

bigIdeas.en: Kidneys filter blood, reabsorb useful substances and excrete urea in urine.
bigIdeas.bm: Ginjal menapis darah, menyerap semula bahan berguna dan mengumuh urea dalam air kencing.

bigIdeas.en: ADH controls how much water the kidneys reabsorb.
bigIdeas.bm: ADH mengawal berapa banyak air yang diserap semula oleh ginjal.

definition.en: Keeping the internal environment within a narrow, constant range.
definition.bm: Mengekalkan persekitaran dalam pada julat malar yang sempit.

definition.en: A change triggers responses that reverse it, back to the set point.
definition.bm: Perubahan mencetuskan gerak balas yang membalikkannya ke titik set.

definition.en: Functional unit of the kidney that filters blood and forms urine.
definition.bm: Unit fungsi ginjal yang menapis darah dan membentuk air kencing.

definition.en: High-pressure filtration of blood from the glomerulus into Bowman's capsule.
definition.bm: Penurasan darah bertekanan tinggi dari glomerulus ke dalam kapsul Bowman.

definition.en: Antidiuretic hormone — increases water reabsorption in the kidneys.
definition.bm: Hormon antidiuresis — meningkatkan penyerapan semula air dalam ginjal.

definition.en: Control of water and salt balance in the body.
definition.bm: Kawalan keseimbangan air dan garam dalam badan.

question.en: Explain how blood glucose returns to normal after eating a sweet meal.
question.bm: Terangkan bagaimana glukosa darah kembali normal selepas makan makanan manis.

steps.en: Blood glucose rises above normal (~5 mmol/L).
steps.bm: Glukosa darah meningkat melebihi normal (~5 mmol/L).

steps.en: Beta cells in the islets of Langerhans (pancreas) detect this and secrete insulin.
steps.bm: Sel beta dalam pulau Langerhans (pankreas) mengesannya dan merembes insulin.

steps.en: Insulin makes cells absorb glucose and the liver convert glucose → glycogen.
steps.bm: Insulin menyebabkan sel menyerap glukosa dan hati menukar glukosa → glikogen.

steps.en: Blood glucose falls back to normal; insulin secretion stops (negative feedback).
steps.bm: Glukosa darah turun ke aras normal; rembesan insulin berhenti (suap balik negatif).

answer.en: Insulin lowers blood glucose by storing it as glycogen; glucagon does the opposite when glucose is low.
answer.bm: Insulin menurunkan glukosa darah dengan menyimpannya sebagai glikogen; glukagon melakukan sebaliknya apabila glukosa rendah.

explanation.en: Insulin: glucose → glycogen. Glucagon: glycogen → glucose.
explanation.bm: Insulin: glukosa → glikogen. Glukagon: glikogen → glukosa.

prompt.en: Select ALL responses when body temperature rises.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA gerak balas apabila suhu badan meningkat.

options.bm: Kelenjar peluh menghasilkan lebih banyak peluh

explanation.en: Shivering happens when it's cold — muscle contraction releases heat.
explanation.bm: Menggigil berlaku apabila sejuk — pengecutan otot membebaskan haba.

prompt.en: Which part of the brain is the control centre for body temperature?
prompt.bm: Bahagian otak manakah pusat kawalan suhu badan?

explanation.en: The hypothalamus also controls water balance through ADH.
explanation.bm: Hipotalamus juga mengawal keseimbangan air melalui ADH.

prompt.en: Put the stages of urine formation in order.

items.en: Urine flows to the collecting duct
items.bm: Air kencing mengalir ke duktus pengumpul

prompt.en: Which substance is normally NOT found in the urine of a healthy person?
prompt.bm: Bahan manakah biasanya TIDAK terdapat dalam air kencing orang sihat?

explanation.en: All glucose is reabsorbed in the proximal tubule. Glucose in urine is a sign of diabetes.
explanation.bm: Semua glukosa diserap semula di tubul proksimal. Glukosa dalam air kencing tanda diabetes.

prompt.en: After sweating a lot on a hot day, your urine is darker and less. Why?
prompt.bm: Selepas banyak berpeluh pada hari panas, air kencing lebih pekat dan sedikit. Mengapa?

options.en: More ADH is released, so more water is reabsorbed
options.bm: Lebih banyak ADH dibebaskan, jadi lebih banyak air diserap semula

explanation.en: Blood becomes more concentrated → hypothalamus → pituitary releases ADH → collecting ducts more permeable to water.
explanation.bm: Darah menjadi lebih pekat → hipotalamus → pituitari membebaskan ADH → duktus pengumpul lebih telap air.

prompt.en: Match each part of the nephron to its job.
prompt.bm: Padankan setiap bahagian nefron dengan tugasnya.

right.bm: Menyerap semula glukosa dan asid amino

explanation.en: About 180 L of filtrate forms per day, but only ~1.5 L of urine is excreted.
explanation.bm: Kira-kira 180 L hasil turasan terbentuk sehari, tetapi hanya ~1.5 L air kencing dikumuh.

prompt.en: A patient with kidney failure may be treated with…
prompt.bm: Pesakit kegagalan ginjal boleh dirawat dengan…

explanation.en: A dialysis machine removes urea and excess salts from blood through a semi-permeable membrane.
explanation.bm: Mesin dialisis menyingkir urea dan garam berlebihan daripada darah melalui membran separa telap.

prompt.en: Kidney stones are often linked to…

options.en: drinking too little water and high salt/calcium intake
options.bm: minum terlalu sedikit air dan pengambilan garam/kalsium yang tinggi

explanation.en: Minerals crystallise in concentrated urine. Drink plenty of water — especially in Malaysia's hot climate.
explanation.bm: Mineral menghablur dalam air kencing pekat. Minum banyak air — terutamanya dalam iklim panas Malaysia.

prompt.en: The mechanism that reverses a change back to normal is called ______ feedback.
prompt.bm: Mekanisme yang membalikkan perubahan kepada normal dipanggil suap balik ______.

explanation.en: Negative feedback keeps conditions close to the set point.
explanation.bm: Suap balik negatif mengekalkan keadaan hampir dengan titik set.
